title: Quantum Key Distribution with a Negatively Charged Quantum Dot Single-Photon Source
summary: Various quantum key distribution (QKD) protocols require bright single-photon sources with a very low probability of multiphoton emission. In this work, we investigate single-photon generation from a negatively charged quantum dot embedded in an elliptical pillar microcavity, driven by either resonant excitation or adiabatic rapid passage (ARP). Our results show that ARP excitation significantly suppresses multiphoton emission and improves photon indistinguishability compared to resonant excitation.
